summary: Teacher creation with required Subjects multi-select — full backend + frontend regression on the deployed preview URL. BACKEND: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_teacher_subjects.py = 6/6 PASS in 1.57s — (1) GET /api/academic/subjects returns seeded subjects; (2) POST /api/users role=teacher with subjects MISSING → 400 with 'subject' in detail; (3) POST role=teacher subjects=[] → 400 with 'subject' in detail; (4) POST role=teacher with valid subjects=[<id>] → 201 and the response + GET /api/users?role=teacher list both echo the subjects array; (5) Teacher with two subject ids round-trips correctly; (6) Accounts role does NOT require subjects (200 even without payload.subjects). FRONTEND (logged in as principal@sunrise.edu / School@123 via the login form): on /school/teachers — (A) Add staff modal under the Teachers tab renders new-user-subjects-wrap + new-user-subjects containing 5 chips (one per seeded subject); initial Selected count = 0. (B) Submitting form with name+email+password but ZERO subjects shows the 'at least one subject' error toast and fires 0 POST /api/users (frontend short-circuits as required). (C) Clicking a chip toggles aria-pressed and updates new-user-subjects-count → 'Selected: 1' / 'Selected: 0' on subsequent clicks. (D) Submitting with 1 subject selected fires exactly 1 POST /api/users which returns 200/201; modal closes, the new teacher email is rendered in the teachers list, and the teacher card has the data-testid='user-subjects-<id>' badge container. (E) Switching to the Accounts tab and opening Add staff hides the entire Subjects section (no new-user-subjects-wrap in DOM) as conditioned on role==='teacher'.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/users.py line 50: Teacher-subject guard is correctly implemented at the API layer — `payload.role == 'teacher' and not (payload.subjects and len(payload.subjects) > 0)` covers both missing AND empty-list cases. Detail message is descriptive and surfaces the legacy 'add as Accounts or non-teaching Staff' guidance.

TeachersPage.jsx CreateUserModal: useEffect resets emptyForm whenever `open` OR `role` changes — correctly clears stale subject selections when the admin toggles tabs Teachers↔Accounts mid-creation. Good.

TeachersPage.jsx submit(): the frontend pre-validation prevents the API call when subjects are empty AND the `if (role !== 'teacher') delete payload.subjects` line keeps the POST body clean for accounts users. No regression risk.

Edge case [F] (subjects = 0 in school): the empty-state JSX with data-testid='new-user-subjects-empty' is correctly placed inside the conditional `subjects.length === 0` branch. Could NOT be exercised via UI on the seeded DEMO school (5 subjects present); covered by code review only.

Card render for u.role==='teacher' shows either `user-subjects-<id>` (when subjects.length>0) or a 'None assigned' warning chip — graceful for legacy teachers without subjects (e.g. priya/rohit/kavita were seeded before this guard).
subjectMap built once from the subjects list — efficient O(1) lookup when rendering badges; uses subject.name with fallback to raw id which is good defensive UI.

Minor (no action needed): backend stores email lowercased; frontend doesn't pre-lowercase before submit which is fine — backend normalizes on insert and on duplicate-check. Test asserts updated accordingly.
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md verbatim — school_admin=principal@sunrise.edu/School@123. Login form auto-defaults role to 'school_admin' so no role-select toggling needed for this account.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created 4 TEST_-prefixed users in Sunrise (TEST_ok_teacher_<ts>, TEST_multi_subj_<ts>, TEST_acc_<ts>) plus one UI-created teacher (ui_test_<ts>@sunrise.edu) with one subject assigned. All clearly identifiable by TEST_ / ui_test_ email prefix. No seeded teachers/subjects modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: auth is cookie-based (POST /api/auth/login sets cookies; response body does NOT include access_token — use requests.Session for pytest, not Authorization header). Subjects multi-select selectors on TeachersPage CreateUserModal: new-user-subjects-wrap (container, teacher-only), new-user-subjects (chip grid), new-user-subject-<subject_id> (per-chip with aria-pressed), new-user-subjects-count (selected count text), new-user-subjects-empty (empty-state inside wrap when no subjects). Teacher list cards expose data-testid='user-subjects-<user_id>' as the subjects-badge wrapper. The 'No subjects in school' empty-state could not be exercised on the DEMO seed (5 subjects exist) — verified by code inspection only. To regression this UI quickly: re-run /app/backend/tests/test_teacher_subjects.py and the Playwright flow that opens add-user-btn under both tab-teacher and tab-accounts.
rca of the issue: Not a bug investigation — this was a feature-validation pass. Implementation is correct on both layers: backend already rejected teacher-without-subjects (line 50 of routes/users.py, no change required) and the new TeachersPage CreateUserModal correctly (a) fetches /api/academic/subjects on mount, (b) renders chips only when role==='teacher', (c) blocks submit + toasts when subjects empty, and (d) passes the subjects array through to POST /api/users which round-trips to GET /api/users?role=teacher.
